|rulings=* Preventing destiny draws from being modified even prevents global modifiers such as from the [[Silence Is Golden (V)]] and the Senate Objective.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=I%20Don%27t%20Like%20Sand%20%28ALT%29 Scomp: I Don't Like Sand]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). * Preventing destiny draws from being modified can be circumvented with a substituted destiny that has been modified ''before'' the substitution (e.g. [[Darklighter Spin]] on a modified maneuver value, or a senator on [[Sando Aqua Monster]] that is already receiving a global modifier from the Senate Objective).
